meaning: 他们一起经历了许多冒险
usageNote: adventure可以是真实冒险，也可以是有趣经历！复数adventures说明次数多，一段佳话的感觉✨

examples.en: They have many adventures together during their road trip across the country.
examples.zh: 他们在横穿全国的公路旅行中一起经历了很多冒险。

examples.en: Best friends since childhood, they have many adventures together every summer.
examples.zh: 从小就是好朋友，他们每个夏天都一起经历许多冒险。
